text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
*Portugal and Angola agree to launch an industrial area for Portuguese industries in Viana, north of Luanda, in Angola, in 1998.
*An agreement in principal to sell Credit Lyonnais branches in Portugal to Spanish bank Caixa da Galicia may be signed today, a source close to the the process told the paper.
*Commission responsible for the study of the reform to Social Security system has got behind in its work and reform only likely in time for the 1999 budget.
*According to a study by Coopers & Lybrand for the restructuring of the Portuguese Copper Company, the company can only keep its activity if 148 jobs are extinguished.
*Banco Finantia says in a market review that Banco Espirito Santo may be preparing a new and important acquisition.
